title: Settings Page
description: Adapter-driven account settings shell. Two-column layout: left section nav (Profile / Preferences / Notifications / Danger zone) + right content panel, collapsing to a Select on mobile. The consumer owns persistence by implementing a SettingsAdapter (load + save); a createMemoryAdapter is shipped for demos. Sections: profile (avatar + name/email/bio), preferences (theme + language + density), notifications (four switch rows), and a destructive danger zone with AlertDialog-confirmed account deletion.
